input: Create a custom playlist for my morning commute

gold.taskTitle: Build a Custom Morning Commute Playlist
gold.taskDescription: Create a personalized playlist tailored to the user's morning commute experience and music preferences.

questions.title: How long is your morning commute in minutes?
questions.description: Understanding the commute duration helps determine the total playlist length needed.

questions.title: What music platform do you use for listening?
questions.description: Knowing the platform (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, etc.) determines where the playlist will be built.

questions.title: What genres or artists do you enjoy most?
questions.description: Identifying preferred genres and artists ensures the playlist feels personal and enjoyable.

questions.title: What mood do you want the playlist to set?
questions.description: Understanding whether the user wants to feel energized, calm, focused, or motivated shapes the song selection.

questions.title: Should the energy level build up gradually or stay consistent?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred energy arc helps structure the order and flow of tracks.

questions.title: Are there any songs or artists you want excluded?
questions.description: Identifying dislikes or overplayed tracks ensures the playlist stays fresh and enjoyable.

questions.title: Do you commute by car, public transit, or on foot?
questions.description: The commute method influences whether lyrics, volume dynamics, or tempo matter more for the listening environment.
